note: Single source of the enclosure geometry (mm). Axes: x right and y up as seen from the front, z from the rear outer face (0) towards the front face (outer.d). Values without a _src key are design choices of this package (build/15 decisions, build/05 rules); part envelopes and their sources are in parts.json. Physical fit, sealing, thermal and drop gates stay OPEN.

outer._src: D15 222.5 x 137.5 x 57.5 grown after the model fit (fit-report.json 'envelope'); decision build/15 'Оболонка D15 може збільшитися'

stack_z._note: front-to-rear stack in the display region

display._src: glass outline and active areas: parts.json display_module; window = larger active area + margin; window centred on the glass (assumption, TBD: re-measure the received panel, STACK D5)

hmi._src: STACK 5.8 (column 38-42 mm, pitch 19-21; 22-25 only if the face height allows: the grown face does, pitch 22); the row order is this package's proposal (STACK lists only the six keys)

piezo_port._src: acoustic ePTFE vent SKU TBD (STACK 2.9 open row)

top_face._src: port pitch 20 mm, types and the order P1..P8 + RX1: STACK 5.8 / 05 5.1

right_face._src: STACK D15 puts RX2/REF IN on the left wall; this model moves them to the right wall next to the LimeSDR (fit-report 'lime_cables', CAB.01075 is 100 mm long); recorded in build/15

left_face._src: path 2 side exhaust (STACK 5.6, side TBD there): left wall downstream of the blower; vents on flat 2.0-3.5 mm pads, never upward (STACK D15)

ports._note: IP2368 sealed USB-C feedthrough, MPN TBD (MECH-07)

intake._src: path 2 bottom intake (STACK 5.6): mesh 316 + Qualtek 09150-M-30 foam cut to 36.4 x 21 in a retaining seat

tripod._src: STACK D15 / 5.8 (captive 1/4-20 UNC steel nut 7/16 in AF, 11.3 AF pocket about 5.8 deep, outer wall <=1.0 with a 6.6 hole, >=3 behind the nut, 100% infill >=4 perimeters)

hatch.lip: bottom edge of the cover hooks under the opening (no screw near the battery)
content: blue USB-A port of the Q6A (reached directly in the plug bay)

strap_slots._src: STACK 5.8 (two slots <=12 for SmallRig PAC2456 in the rear half); on the left of the rear face so the left hand holds the unit while the right hand works the HMI column

t7_gland._src: STACK 5.8 puts the T7 gland on the bottom edge; with the battery strip along the bottom it moves to the rear face next to the T7 holder (fit-report)

t7_holder._src: STACK 5.8 (holder 85 x 57 x 8, gap 3-5, reflective shutter); T7 stands vertical at the rear bottom-left, clear of the tripod plate (disc of 50 mm around the 1/4-20)

closure.sealing_washer: M3 bonded seal / EPDM washer under the head (MPN TBD)
closure._src: inserts CNC Kitchen M3x5.7 and ISO 14580 screws: STACK 2.9

gasket._src: EPDM cord in a groove (build/15); squeeze and fill rule: parts.json oring_groove_rule

plate.material: EN AW-5754 (AlMg3) 2.0 mm, mill finish; alt. 1050A-H14 or 6082-T6
plate.bottom_edge: the lower plate edge rests on the battery-tray rib through a 1 mm insulating strip (not screwed)
plate._riser_window_note: slot between the Q6A top edge (y 93.5) and the RF-bay bottom wall (y 97): the R44SF card-edge end (about 22 mm wide) is threaded through it; STACK 5.8 estimated about 26 x 20, check on the received riser (TBD)

bond_points.note: single RF GND / CHASSIS bond (13-pcb-preparation 'RF GND/CHASSIS bond'): M3 + serrated washer on bare metal

plate._src: STACK 5.8 (2.0 mm Al, holes +-0.2, flatness <=0.2 under Q6A, pedestal and regulator pads, no thread cut in the plate; riser window about 26 x 20)

layout._note: Envelope boxes [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz]; mount: plate_rear (hangs from the plate), plate_front, rear_wall, front_wall, rf_lid, free. part = key in parts.json, board = key in boards.json. keep_clear boxes reserve space (plugs, cable bends) and must stay empty.

items._note: HDMI ferrite pocket 1 (Fair-Rite 0431164281 39.5 x 20 x 19.6, STACK 5.8 about 40 x 20 x 20); pocket 2: no 20 mm deep space left on the cable route in this layout (TBD, build/05 11)

rf_bay.material: FR4 copper clad 35/35 um, 1.5-1.6 mm (Bungard 120306Z33 or Scankemi 1.6, STACK 2.9)

notches.use: 2x RG316 K401/K402 to the HF+ can (row below)
USB 2.0 lead of V4L-A (RTL-A) to the hub / Q6A
USB 2.0 lead of V4L-B (RTL-B) to the hub
RF board power / DC_CORE harness (JST PH) and U.FL to Lime RX1

rf_bay._usb_socket_src: female end of the V4L extension lead (Lindy 36700 or a CH334F pigtail, STACK C5 / 2.10): no drawing read; 40 x 16 x 9 mm is an assumption (TBD: measure) used only by the bay packing check
rf_bay._note: floor = plate, top side = top Al angle + top wall; FR4 walls on the left, bottom and right; the FR4 lid carries the modules (rf_lid mount); notches are cut at the lid edge of the bottom wall

angles.material: EN AW-6060 L angle 15 x 12 x 2 (cut from 20 x 20 x 2 or 2.0 mm 5754 bent), screwed to the plate (STACK 5.8 'стінка 4-5: ASA + 2 мм Al')

lime_pedestal.material: Al 6082 or 5754 bar (STACK 2.9 blank 25x25x75 or 10 mm 50x50)
lime_pedestal._note: pad_gap = design gap between the pedestal top and the Lime bottom-side parts (1.35 mm, STACK 5.8), set by the height of the M.2 card fixing; gap_tol is an assumed stack tolerance (TBD: measure)

ufs_boss.material: Al 6082 or 5754, bonded or screwed to the plate rear face (bare metal)
ufs_boss._src: centre: Radxa Dragon Q6A 2D drawing V1.21, bottom view, 43.6 mm from the RJ45 edge and 23.1 mm from the HDMI edge (https://dl.radxa.com/dragon/q6a/hw/radxa_dragon_q6a_2d_dimensions_v1.21.pdf, read 2026-10-24); module_outline 18.5 x 13.5 is scaled from that drawing's vector rectangle (not a printed dimension); contact = outline - 1 mm per side; module_below_board 2.5 is an assumption (TBD: measure the gap with the module fitted, components/storage.md 'boss height = gap - 0.75 x pad'); the earlier 'about 28 x 20' rib of components/storage.md is larger than the drawn module and is not used

cu_block._note: cooler A: flat face on the SoC (paste or PTM7950), face over the LPDDR5 recessed by ram_recess for a Gelid pad (STACK 5.8: never one pad over SoC and RAM); SoC and LPDDR5 tops from the Q6A STEP V1.21 (parts.json q6a); gap_tol is an assumed package/flatness tolerance (TBD)

pwr_bond._note: PWR board on the plate front face: Gelid pad under the regulator zones, gap fixed by 0.4 mm shim washers at the screws (shim part TBD, MECH-04)

fins._note: bonded Al fin strips on the plate front face under the HDMI board, along the path-2 flow (STACK 5.6 'ребра пластини')

q6a_mount.map: x = x0 + 85 - u, y = y0 + v (component side towards the rear)
q6a_mount._src: Radxa V1.21 2D drawing and STEP (board 85 x 56, holes 3.5 from the edges); SoC/LPDDR5/M.2 J13 positions from the STEP product names BGA1287/BGA315 and components/mechanical_thermal.md

print._src: STACK 2.9 / 5.8 (ASA in a closed ventilated chamber; tripod boss 100 % infill with >=4 perimeters)
